params.description: Indicates whether email address syntax is valid.

params.name: catchAll
params.description: Indicates catch all status of email address.

params.name: disposable
params.description:
Indicates whether email address is disposable.
A disposable email address is a temporary address that is often used for short-term purposes and can be discarded after use.

params.name: roleBased
params.description:
Indicates whether email address is role-based.
A role-based email address is one that is associated with a specific function or group within an organization,
such as marketing@example.org, rather than an individual person.

params.description:

The date cannot be more than 1 month in the past.
